d: Our client is looking for a detail-oriented Freight Management Executive to support shipment execution and tracking across its freight operations.
The role will coordinate container bookings, monitor shipments, manage operational exceptions, support freight rate negotiations, and keep freight records and reconciliations accurate.
q: Experience in freight, shipping, logistics, or supply chain operations.
Familiarity with container bookings, freight forwarders, shipping lines, and shipment tracking.
Understanding of vessel schedules, ETA/ETD updates, transshipments, and shipment milestones.
Experience with freight rate comparisons, invoice checks, or account reconciliations.
Strong coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage operational exceptions.
Good attention to detail and confidence maintaining trackers, dashboards, and records.
Clear communication skills when working with suppliers, planners, freight forwarders, and internal teams.
r: li
Ensure container bookings are made in line with freight forwarder commitments.
li
Coordinate daily operational calls with suppliers, freight forwarders, and planners to track shipments.
li
Monitor containers in transit, including vessel movements, ETAs and ETDs, transshipments, and key milestones.
li
Maintain shipment visibility dashboards, exception logs, and escalation trackers.
li
Coordinate planner requests for changes of destination (COD) and shipment termination.
li
Coordinate shipments using the Oman–UAE land bridge.
li
Prepare information for freight RFQs and comparative analyses to support negotiations with freight forwarders and shipping lines.
li
Maintain agreed freight rates by month or shipment, along with freight agreement records.
li
Work with the documentation team to validate supplier invoices against agreed rates and supporting documents.
li
Perform regular statement of account (SOA) reconciliations and maintain accurate records.
li
Review freight forwarder performance against agreed service levels and follow up on issues.

d: We are looking for an experienced Manager – Data Privacy Governance to oversee the implementation and operational management of the organization's data privacy framework, ensuring compliance with applicable UAE and international data protection regulations.

This role will play a key part in strengthening enterprise-wide privacy governance, managing privacy risks, and ensuring effective implementation of data protection policies and controls across business units and group entities.
q: Bachelor's degree in Law, Information Security, Risk Management, Information Technology or a related discipline.
Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in data protection, privacy governance, regulatory compliance or risk management.
At least 2 years of supervisory or managerial experience.
Strong knowledge of UAE Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and its Executive Regulations.
Good understanding of CBUAE regulatory requirements, particularly those relating to data protection, consent and consumer protection.
Proven experience managing enterprise privacy programs, including RoPA, DPIAs, data subject rights, breach management and third-party privacy governance.
Practical experience with privacy management platforms such as OneTrust and GRC tools such as Archer .
Experience within banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry is strongly preferred.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, reporting and regulatory engagement skills.
Professional certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, CDPO, CISA, CISM or equivalent are an advantage.
Knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR, DIFC Data Protection Law and ADGM Data Protection Regulations is also desirable.
r: li
Develop, maintain and oversee the Data Privacy Framework, policies, standards, procedures and supporting governance documentation.
li
Manage the Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) program, ensuring accurate data mapping and periodic reviews across business units.
li
Oversee Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), privacy risk assessments and international data transfer assessments.
li
Ensure compliance with UAE Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), CBUAE requirements and other applicable data protection regulations.
li
Govern data subject rights, consent management, privacy notices and personal data breach management.
li
Oversee third-party privacy assessments, vendor due diligence and Data Processing Agreements (DPAs).
li
Monitor privacy risks, audit findings and remediation activities, ensuring timely closure.
li
Prepare privacy KPIs, KRIs and governance reports for senior management and relevant committees.
li
Drive privacy awareness and training initiatives across the organization.
li
Provide guidance and direction to privacy analysts and business stakeholders, supporting the DPO where required.
